Im Gelände fordert er Toyota-Offroad-Experte Alexander Wohlfarth in seinem Toyota Hilux zum Duell. Wer schlägt sich besser im Gelände und bringt gleichzeitig noch genügend Alltagstauglichkeit mit?

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: A alemã Kati é uma entusiasta americana de automóveis. Junto com seu namorado Patrick, ela realizou seu sonho e comprou um Chevy Chevelle de 1972. A raridade foi descoberta por Frank Slopianka e sua empresa "Special Cars Berlin" nos EUA.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: Alpina B5 Touring vs. Jaguar XF Sportbrake
programme.desc: Motorvision TV testet Allrad-Kombis aus der Kompakt-, Mittel- und Oberklasse. Der Alpina B5 Touring. Mit 608 PS, 325 km/h Top-Speed und nur 3,6 Sekunden auf Tempo 100 ist er der schnellste Kombi der Welt. Nicht zu unterschätzen ist der Skoda Octavia Combi: solide, zuverlässig aber wenig emotional. In Deutschland ein Exot auf den Straßen: der Jaguar XF Sportbrake - der Kombi für Individualisten.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Não muito longe de Stuttgart está a casa do afinador Performmaster, especializado na otimização do desempenho dos modelos Mercedes-AMG. Eles transformaram o já mais que potente carro esportivo GT S em uma fera.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Apesar de um número de produção de quase 1,4 milhões de unidades, o Chevrolet Corvair é praticamente desconhecido na Europa. Ele era inovador, eficiente, moderno e barato. No entanto, foi caluniado, despedaçado e mais tarde insultado.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Das Gefühl von grenzenloser Freiheit und Abenteuer vermitteln nur echte Offroader. Der Land Rover Defender wurde 2016 nach über 60 Jahren eingestellt, doch die Briten haben einen Nachfolger angekündigt. Optisch könnte er sich an dem Discovery orientieren. Der 'Disco' in der fünften Generation ist Kompromiss aus Offroader und Luxus-Laster.4x4 - das Allrad Magazin hat ihn im Bergwerk unter Tage getestet.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Nos Estados Unidos, os utilitários esportivos não são geralmente considerados simples cavalos de trabalho, mas sim tratados como veículos comuns do dia-a-dia. Os norte-americanos não querem perder espaço, conforto e capacidade de carga. Seu lema é: quanto maior, melhor. Chevrolet Suburban, Jeep Cherokee, GMC Yukon, mostramos-lhe o mundo dos offroaders norte-americanos.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: SUVs sind nach wie vor beliebt und das Segment wird immer größer. Besonders kleine SUVs drängen auf den Markt. Sie sind optimal für die Stadt, Offroad-Fähigkeiten spielen kaum noch eine Rolle. Der Seat Arona ist mit knapp über vier Metern Länge ein typischer Vertreter. Ein anderer Pseudo-Offroader ist der VW T-Roc. Kann das kleinste VW-SUV an den Erfolg des Bestsellers VW Tiguan anschließen?

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Os utilitários esportivos geralmente são bastante impressionantes fora da fábrica, mas há muitas opções de afinação e personalização: rodas enormes, cores loucas e perfomance semelhante aos carros super esportivos. Pode-se perguntar se tais alterações são realmente necessárias, mas os entusiastas estão entusiasmados. Neste episódio apresentamos a Kelleners BMW X5, o Mercedes Brabus B63 e o Porsche Cayenne sintonizado pela Techart.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: 'Wenn du einen Jeep besitzt, sind wir alles, was du brauchst.' Das schreiben sich die Jungs von ORZ Vehicles auf die Fahne. Mit dem Handel und der Montage von Jeep-Zubehör machen sie den amerikanischen Offroad-Traum für Europa wahr. Bestes Beispiel dafür ist der Brute - eine Pickup-Variante des Wranglers, die mit dem Serienmodell kaum noch etwas zu tun hat.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: À primeira vista, carros compactos como o Audi A1, o Volkswagen Golf e o Mini não parecem pertencer a esta série, mas quando o "A1" se torna o "S1" e o Golf recebe um "R" em seu nome, estes pequenos carros se transformam em bestas de todas as rodas. Além disso: o Mini Countryman recebe um rejuvenescimento. E: um test drive com o Volvo XC60, o mais vendido.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Der Jaguar XF-S soll BMW, Audi und Co. in der Business-Klasse ganz schön einheizen. V6-Power, 380 PS und Allradantrieb lauten die Zutaten, um den deutschen Platzhirschen das Fürchten zu lehren. Einen anderen Ansatz betreibt Volvo: Der S90 besticht mit skandinavischem Design und sparsamen Vierzylinder-Motoren. Allrad-Alternativen für die Mittelklasse.

programme.title: Ilha de Man - Troféu Turístico, Parte 1
programme.desc: Troféu Turístico na Ilha de Man. Todos os anos, realiza-se a corrida de motociclismo mais perigosa do mundo. Uma volta do Troféu Turístico tem 61 quilómetros de comprimento. 260 curvas exigem tudo dos cavaleiros. Trata-se de um mito único.

programme.title: Ilha de Man - Troféu Turístico, Parte 2
programme.desc: A corrida de motocicletas mais perigosa do mundo na Ilha de Man. Os marechais do TT são responsáveis pela máxima segurança.

programme.title: Der Geheimtipp unter den Businesslimousinen: Der Jaguar XJ R
programme.desc: Königliche Eleganz aus dem Hause Jaguar. Der XJ ist das Flaggschiff der britischen Marke, hat es auf dem deutschen Markt jedoch sehr schwer. Nur 220 Exemplare wurden 2015 in Deutschland verkauft. Woran das liegt, versucht Motorvision heraus zu bekommen.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: A Escalada de Pikes Peak Hill de 1987. Um tipo de corrida bastante diferente nas montanhas do Colorado, EUA. É única, fascinante e cheia de aventura.

programme.title: Hail Toyota International Rally
programme.desc: Die Hail Toyota International Rally 2025 in Saudi-Arabien ist die 25. Ausgabe dieser Wüstenrallye.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Desde 1934, o Grande Prêmio tem sido o campeonato mundial mais emocionante e fascinante do mundo. Com seus veículos de última geração, com a potência das maiores marcas, ela nunca deixa de impressionar seus espectadores.

programme.title: Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Die Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge ist eine internationale Rallye-Raid-Veranstaltung, die seit 1991 im Emirat Abu Dhabi in den Vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten stattfindet.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.sub-title: Rallye Ano 1972 - Uma Historia de Sucesso Ford
programme.desc: O Campeonato Internacional de Fabricantes foi uma série de rallys de 1970-72. Fabricantes de automóveis como Porsche, Renault e Ford participaram, com a Ford tendo um ano de excepcional sucesso em 1972.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve'
programme.desc: Um carro de corrida icônico e um dos únicos 29 já construídos! Acompanhamos o Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve' em sua estréia no Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Africa Eco Race
programme.desc: Die 16. Ausgabe des Africa Eco Race findet in Marokko, Mauretanien und Senegal statt.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: A versão longa da Bentley Mulsanne é um excelente exemplo de uma limusine com chope. Com ela, a marca britânica de carros de luxo colocou a fasquia extremamente alta quando se trata de conforto automotivo.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Eles são extremamente barulhentos, extremamente rápidos e extremamente aperfeiçoados: os carros compactos Mercedes A45 AMG Performmaster e MTM Audi RS3 R. Ferrari e Rolls-Royce, duas das marcas de carros mais famosas do mundo, não precisam de nenhuma afinação. MOTORVISION TV - #SPOTTED explica o mito da Ferrari e dá uma olhada nos bastidores da produção da Rolls Royce Bespoke.

programme.title: Tour European Rally Championship
programme.desc: Die Rally of Nations in Mexiko wird 2025 zum ersten Mal auf Asphalt ausgetragen.

programme.title: Ken Block bei der Rallyecross Weltmeisterschaft
programme.desc: Ken Block, ein Allroundtalent! In der Rallyecross Weltmeisterschaft fahrt er gegen die besten Rallyefahrer der Welt.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: É a estrada mais lendária do mundo: a Rota 66 de Chicago a Santa Monica. Outrora a principal rota de viagem e economia, ela agora vive como a rua mais icônica dos Estados Unidos. Ela representa a "American Way of Drive" como nenhuma outra. Ao longo da velha rodovia, você pode experimentar o mito da Rota 66. Além disso, a estrada 66: Um pacote duplo de GTR com o Nissan GTR e Mercedes-AMG GT R.

programme.title: Der Toyota BJ 42 aus den Achtzigern im Offroad-Training
programme.desc: Die Offroad-Toyota-Instruktoren Alexander Wohlfahrt und Roland Ackerer zeigen, wie man mit alter und robuster Technik die Herausforderungen im Gelände perfekt meistert. Der Toyota BJ 42 erweist sich als standfester und verlässlicher Offroader.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2018 erhielt der Audi R8 Quattro Performance ein Upgrade. Die neue Version teilte sich einige seiner aerodynamischen Eigenschaften mit dem Lamborghini Huracan. Außerdem: der Porsche Macan S bekam einen stärkeren Motor.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Der Sound des McLaren 720S Spider ist der einer kompromisslosen Fahrmaschine. Außerdem: Der F-Pace SVR macht einen eher kultivierten Eindruck. Und: Ist der höhere Preis des Porsche Cayenne Coupés im Vergleich zum normalen Modell gerechtfertigt?

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Com seu Modelo S, o fabricante americano de carros Tesla quer estabelecer motores elétricos na classe de tamanho completo. Pela primeira vez, é possível atingir faixas de direção superiores a 400 quilômetros. Sua tremenda aceleração se torna um impulso de imagem para a marca. Porsche também significa muita velocidade e potência. Com seu Panamera Sport Turismo, o fabricante de carros esportivos entra em um novo mercado.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Wie viel Power steckt in der Limited Edition des Seat Cupra Ateca? Außerdem: sind der Porsche 718 Boxster und der Cayman in der GTS-Version eine Alternative zum teuren 911er? Und: die Vorpremiere von Audis Power-Kombi RS6.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Die Wiedergeburt des französischen Chic, der elegante DS 9 von Citroens Nobelmarke. Außerdem: der Genesis GV80 bietet Luxus zum kleinen Preis. Und: eine Testfahrt im exorbitant teuren Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Toyota GT86 J-Sport
programme.desc: Com o Toyota GT 86 da J-Sport, é perceptível que as raízes da empresa estão nas corridas. O desejo dos fãs de dar ao racer japonês um poder significativamente maior, no entanto, não foi atendido.

programme.title: BMW M3 Test Drive - A BMW de maior sucesso de todos os tempos!
programme.desc: Nos anos 80, a BMW lançou um carro que tinha verdadeiros genes de corrida, o M3. Originalmente concebido como modelo de homologação para o Campeonato Alemão de Carros de Turismo, tornou-se num dos carros desportivos de estrada mais quentes do mundo.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Carros personalizados do deserto: na Garagem do Ron na Califórnia, as obras de arte rolantes são criadas de acordo com os desejos do cliente. E mais: a Mercedes-Benz transforma o Classe G em um sonho de sobrevivência G 63 AMG 6x6. E: o Brabus B63.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Elektroautos der Spitzenklasse. Der Mercedes EQS 450+ stellt sich unserem Test in den Schweizer Alpen. Ist der Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo Turbo S die ultimative Allzweckwaffe? Und: Auf der gleichen Plattform wie der Taycan, der Audi E-Tron GT.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: A MTM transforma o RS6 no RS6 R Clubsport. Também: Stefan Kalläne chulo um Volkswagen Lupo ao extremo. Na Tuning Expo Saarbrücken ele procura os gadgets mais quentes da cena de tuning de carros.

programme.title: Porsche 911 GT3: Ein Rennwagen aus dem Lehrbuch
programme.desc: Ein Porsche 911 alleine ist schon krass. Ein Porsche 911 GT3 ist nochmal ein anderes Niveau. Auch für die Rennstrecke konzipiert, schenkt er seinen Fahrern einen Adrenalinkick, der es wahrlich in sich hat.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Der deutsche Unternehmer Tillmann Miritz ist Oldtimer-Fan durch und durch. Sein Traum: mit seinem Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5 durch die USA. Dazu muss sein Prachtstück per Schiff über den Atlantik gebracht werden. Tillmann nutzt die Gelegenheit und fährt mit seinem Luxus Cabrio die Côte d'Azur entlang und besucht malerische Orte und einen bemerkenswerten Oldtimersammler. Nach einer Spritztour im goldenen Rolls Royce und in einem "göttlichen" Citroen DS wird es Zeit, den 280er in Marseille zu verschiffen, damit das amerikanische Abenteuer endlich beginnen kann.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: O Scirocco GT-R1 da Mathilda Racing, o Bentley GT3 R e o Volkswagen Golf R. O Scirocco é uma conversão completa. O Bentley GT3 R é a versão de rua do atual corredor de GT3. E o Golf R é o Golf mais poderoso de todos os tempos.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Em Dubai, a lendária frota policial de carros super esportivos está à caça de velocistas e violadores de estacionamento. Também: o Audi S8 MTM Talladega R. E: o Alpina D5 na pista de corrida.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: In der Stadt, die niemals schläft, beginnt der deutsche Unternehmer Tillmann Miritz seinen Trip mit dem eigenen Oldtimer zu den Autoikonen seiner Jugend im Land seiner Träume. Mit einem von Süd-Frankreich hierher verschifften Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5 besucht er den legendären New Yorker Oldtimerdealer Elliot Cuker. Mit seiner Leidenschaft für alte Autos hat Cuker mitten in Manhattan sein Glück gemacht und es vom drittklassigen Schauspieler zum Muli-Millionär gebracht. Eine automobile Lebensgeschichte aus dem Big Apple.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: A série BMW 3, Nissan 370 Z ou Citroen DS3 são geralmente considerados carros comuns. Mas na versão M, como um Nismo ou como um Musketier, as coisas se resumem em termos de desempenho.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Gelebte Oldtimertraume - Long Island / Railroad to Florida
programme.desc: Über die Manhattan-Bridge hinaus nach Long Island führt der Weg von Tillmann Miritz, der mit seinem Oldtimer auf den Weg ist, um automobile Raritäten in den USA aufzuspüren. Im Indian Summer gleitet das Mercedes Cabriolet hinaus auf das Weingut Wölffer des deutschen Winzers Roman Roth, der hier einen der besten Weine der Welt anbaut. In seiner Garage findet sich ein automobiler Traum: Ein 3100er Chevi Pick Up Truck. Eines jender Fahrzeuge, das die Automobilgeschichte in den USA bis heute geprägt hat.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: O curso de gelo em Lungauring, o Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 em treinamento de inverno. Doze participantes foram ensinados a arte de andar à deriva com um carro com tração nas quatro rodas. Acompanhamos um aluno em sua primeira experiência de drifting.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Italienische Sportwagen gelten nicht zu Unrecht als Krone dieser Fahrzeugklasse. Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini, Alfa Romeo - kennt praktisch jeder. Aber Iso Rivolta? Die Marke ist verschwunden aber unter Auto-Enthusiasten lebt die Legende weiter. Im Sarasota Classic Car Museum, Florida finden sich gleich mehrere mit amerikanischen Corvette V8-Motoren ausgerüstete Rivoltas aus der Feder des legendären intalienischen Designers und Tillmann wird vom Rivolta-Enkel Renzo zu einer Ausfahrt im wunderbaren Grifo GT eingeladen. Nicht weit vom Museum entfernt bauen die Rivoltas Enkel heute wieder Traum-Fahrzeuge - allerdings fürs Wasser.

programme.title: Toyota Corolla Levin
programme.desc: Em 1970, a segunda geração do Corolla foi lançada no Japão. O modelo esportivo "Levin", semelhante ao Volkswagen Golf GTI entre os Corollas, só foi disponibilizado no Japão e nos Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Dê uma olhada nos modelos híbridos mais acessíveis. Os pioneiros são definitivamente os japoneses, que têm um monte de carros para oferecer.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Welches ist das amerikanische Auto der 60er? Das Sinnbild amerikanischer Autobaukunst dieser Zeit? Keine Frage, die meisten US-Car Fans würden antworten: Chevrolet Corvette oder der Ford Mustang. Auf der Suche nach diesen amerikanischen Traumautos macht Tillmann Miritz bei seiner Reise durch Florida eine überraschende Entdeckung. Bei REVOLOGY CARS in Orlando werden originale 1964er Ford Mustang Karossen in Handarbeit mit modernster Technik und Motoren ausgestattet und Tillmann darf mit einer dieser wunderbaren Replikas eine Probefahrt unternehmen.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.sub-title: Os fabricantes de carros mais antigos
programme.desc: Os dez fabricantes de automóveis mais antigos. Em quem você pensa ser o pioneiro. Nos últimos anos, um número substancial de fabricantes de automóveis comemorou aniversários.

programme.title: Jaguar XF S - Business-Klasse mit britischen Charme
programme.desc: Bricht jetzt die Nacht über die deutschen Limousinen herein? Ein angriffslustiger Brite macht ernst. Der Jaguar XF ist die alternative Business-Kutsche zu den Etablierten aus Deutschland. Und als S-Variante macht er sogar richtig Spaß.

programme.title: Morgan AR P4 - Limitierte Sonderedition
programme.desc: Der Plus 4 ist das erfolgreichste Modell von Morgan. Der AR P4 ist eine limitierte Version, die zum 65. Jubilaum des Modells entstand und von der Rennsportabteilung "AR" aufgebaut wurde. Nur 50 Exemplare dieses Autos wurden jemals gebaut.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Hoje em dia, tudo se resume a lendas. Descubra dez carros que não são apenas um simples meio de transporte, mas que conseguiram adquirir um status icônico. Eles influenciaram gerações inteiras.

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Bei der Porsche Exclusive Manufaktur ist der Name Programm - hier werden die sowieso schon hochklassigen Fahrzeuge der Marke mit feinsten und besten Materialien individuell veredelt. Außerdem: die Neuauflage von Seats SUV Ateca im Test.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Os departamentos de projeto dos fabricantes de automóveis estão tentando fazer o carro perfeito. E, em sua maioria, carros muito elegantes são o resultado. Mas existem criações que levantam seriamente a questão do gosto de seus designers.

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Welche Rolle wird die Digitalisierung im zukünftigen Automobilbau spielen? Wir suchen bei Porsche Digital nach Antworten auf diese Frage. Außerdem: ausgerechnet ein Skoda entwickelte sich in Neuseeland in den 1960er und -70er Jahren zum Geländewagen-Klassiker in Neuseeland. Und: der Volkswagen Arteo shooting brake im Test sowie ein Ausflug zur Toyota-Winterfahrschule in Saalfelden im Defender.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Tem sido dito que a beleza está nos olhos de quem a vê. Portanto, vamos dar uma olhada mais de perto nos dez carros mais bonitos de todos os tempos.

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Der Macan ist eines der erfolgreichsten Porsche-Modelle. Wir widmen uns der Neuauflage des Macan Turbo. Außerdem: der Hyundai i20 im Test sowie eine weitere Runde in der Toyota-Winterfahrschule in Saalfelden, dieses Mal im RAV4 und im klassischen Land Cruiser BJ 42.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Veja a série mais rara de carros. Aqueles que são limitados e exclusivos. Obviamente, isto também aumenta imediatamente a conveniência. Quer seja o Lexus LFA ou o Bugatti Veyron.

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Nach über 70 Jahren präsentiert Land Rover eine Neuauflage des Geländewagen-Klassikers Defender. Außerdem: der Weltrekordversuch im Driften im Porsche Taycan am Hockenheimring. Und: der Porsche 911 Turbo und der 718 Spyder im Test.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Neste episódio, convidamos você a testemunhar o progresso do motorista Uwe Nittle ao se preparar para a qualificação no Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Treibstoff der Zukunft? Wasserstoff und Windkraft? Der Hamburger Flughafen experimentiert mit der klimaneutralen Produktion von Kerosin. Außerdem: sechs Generationen Porsche 911 Turbo am Hockenheimring mit Ex-Rallye-Weltmeister Walter Röhrl. Und: der Supersportwagen Aston Martin DBS Superleggera im Fahrbericht sowie der Q2, Audis kleinster SUV, im Test.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: O Desafio RCN é a derradeira experiência de condução da BMW. Fizemos também uma visita ao Devils Diner, o ponto de encontro interno da pista para os motoristas.

programme.title: 100.000€ mehr für 30 PS? | Giulia GTAm: Der schärfste Alfa aller Zeiten
programme.desc: Die Alfa Romeo Giulia GTA kostet ab 173.000€ - ein stolzer Preis für eine Sport-Limousine. Was hat das limitierte Topmodell neben den 30 Extra-PS noch zu bieten? Und ist der Preis wirklich gerechtfertigt. Das untersuchen wir auf den kurvigen Straßen des Taunus-Gebirge.

programme.title: Der Hyundai Nexo setzt auf die Wasserstoff-Brennzelle - der beste Antrieb fürs Klima?
programme.desc: Das Nexo-Antriebskonzept des koreanischen Herstellers, der auch Hybrid- und Elektroantriebe herstellt, besteht aus drei Komponenten: Die Brennstoffzellen gewinnen die Energie, eine Hochvolt-Batterie puffert und der Elektromotor bringt die Power schließlich auf die Straße.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Após o término da corrida de 24 horas, deixamos o Nürburgring e nos mudamos para Büren, Alemanha, onde a empresa Raeder Motorsport está sediada. Eles são famosos pela tração dianteira com um grande desempenho que coloca uma grande potência na pista.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Wir begleiten den US-Car-Händler Frank Slopianka in seinem Camaro zum Drag Racing Event "Race@Airport". Außerdem: das Tuning-Unternehmen Mansory steht für ein Plus an Leistung bei Lamborghini, wie auch beim Mansory Torofeo auf Basis des Huracan.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Os ruídos dos motores e exaustores geralmente dominam o Nürburgring, mas desta vez nos concentramos em algo um pouco mais silencioso. Que tal participar de um passeio de 15 milhas de bicicleta ao redor do ringue, ou talvez uma corrida de 16 milhas?

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: De 2006 a 2012, a empresa alemã Artega produziu seu modelo de carro esportivo GT. Graças ao know-how de um antigo gerente da Porsche e da BMW, a Artega GT pôde ser fabricada em uma pequena série.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Der Nürburgring ist die gefährlichste und zugleich schönste Rennstrecke der Welt und Treffpunkt für Rennsport-Ikonen und -Raritäten. Auch der "Sport1 Trackday" zieht jedes Jahr Tausende von Auto- und Motorsportbegeisterten an.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka é apaixonado por velocidade e participa constantemente de eventos de corrida, como a lendária Corrida 61, 50 quilômetros ao norte de Berlim. É aqui que participantes de toda a Europa competem na viagem aérea do museu da aviação na corrida de uma oitava milha. Frank corre com seu Dragster-Camaro de 700 cavalos para defender o título.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE encontra a America - Cote d'Azur
programme.desc: O empresário alemão Tillmann Miritz começa seu sonho na cidade que nunca dorme: uma viagem na estrada em seu próprio carro antigo até os ícones automotivos de sua juventude. Em seu Mercedes 280 SE 3,5 conversível ele visita o lendário revendedor de carros clássico Eliot Cuker em Nova York, que fez fortuna com sua paixão por carros antigos no centro de Manhattan.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Ola Stenegard, Chef-Designer von BMW Motorrad, trifft in Los Angeles Customizer wie Michael Woolaway und Alan Stulberg. Außerdem: wir zeigen die verrücktesten "Homemade Supercars" wie den Fahrradi Farfalla FFX, den langsamsten Sportwagen der Welt.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE encontra a America - New York
programme.desc: A viagem de Tillmann Miritz para encontrar raridades automotivas nos EUA se estende da Ponte de Manhattan até Long Island. Seu Mercedes conversível o leva para o vinhedo da propriedade Wöllfer, onde alguns dos melhores vinhos são cultivados. Seu proprietário esconde na garagem uma caminhonete que representa o estilo de vida rural americano como quase nenhum outro carro: o Chevrolet 3100.

programme.title: Incrível Jaguar F-Type R Tuning: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: Um Jaguar que pode atacar o medo no mundo apenas com o seu rugido. Este Jaguar Arden-tuned F-Type R é um verdadeiro mau rapaz. Já tem uma verdadeira dentada na configuração padrão, mas o Arden é mais forte, mais alto e mais agressivo.

programme.title: Kassenschlager: Die BMW GS Serie
programme.desc: Hochwertig, teuer und - weltweit ein Kassenschlager: Seit 1980 ist die BMW GS auf dem Markt, zunachst noch unter dem Namen G Strich S. Damals war sie eine Revolution: ein völlig neuartiges Bike fürs Gelande und für die Straße. Bis heute ist sie eines der erfolgreichsten Motorrader aller Zeiten.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: O destaque do XJR está sob o capô: todos os modelos superiores da Jaguar são equipados com o motor compressor V8 de 5 litros que fornece 550 cavalos de potência neste sedan esportivo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Levamos o Mercedes AMG SLS GT para um aeródromo e o Porsche 911 Turbo S para a pista de corrida para ver estas máquinas de condução esportiva em ação e testar seu desempenho. Além disso: a inovadora tecnologia de iluminação do Audi R8 4.0 TFSI.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2018 erhielt der Audi R8 Quattro Performance ein Upgrade. Die neue Version teilte sich einige seiner aerodynamischen Eigenschaften mit dem Lamborghini Huracan. Außerdem: der Porsche Macan S bekam einen stärkeren Motor.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A Jaguar encontrou seu caminho de volta ao mundo dos carros esportivos. O F-Type não tem apenas boa aparência, ele tem o que é preciso e o carro é capaz de enfrentar a competição como o BMW Z4. Também examinamos mais de perto dois outros concorrentes, o Porsche Boxster S e o 370 Z da Nissan.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Por mais de 60 anos, o Corvette tem sido a encarnação do carro esportivo americano. Também: o Ford Mustang GT, um modelo icônico com um motor V8. E: o Chevrolet Camaro, outro clássico da terra onde a cilindrada ainda é muito valorizada.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Wie viel Power steckt in der Limited Edition des Seat Cupra Ateca? Außerdem: sind der Porsche 718 Boxster und der Cayman in der GTS-Version eine Alternative zum teuren 911er? Und: die Vorpremiere von Audis Power-Kombi RS6.

programme.title: Lamborghini Huracan - Sobrecarregado por O.CT
programme.desc: Muita potência graças a um compressor. Este O.CT Lamborghini Huracán otimizado fornece mais de 800 cavalos de potência para fazer o sangue fluir.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Die Wiedergeburt des französischen Chic, der elegante DS 9 von Citroens Nobelmarke. Außerdem: der Genesis GV80 bietet Luxus zum kleinen Preis. Und: eine Testfahrt im exorbitant teuren Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Morgan ARP4
programme.desc: Desde 1950, a Morgan +4 tem sido a base da produção da Morgan. O ARP4 é o último acréscimo à família +4 e está estritamente limitado a uma tiragem de 50.

programme.title: Um carro único: O Beradino
programme.desc: Uma "bella macchina", um belo carro - mas não projetado por mestres como Bertone ou Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen de Neuss na Alemanha construiu o Beradino à mão.

programme.title: 1920: Die letzte Schlacht
programme.desc: Im August 1920 kommt es vor den Toren Warschaus zu einer Schlacht, die den Lauf der europäischen Geschichte für alle Zeiten prägen wird: Es herrscht Krieg zwischen Polen und Russland, die Rote Armee marschiert unaufhaltsam auf die Hauptstadt zu. Nur ein Wunder kann die Niederlage der polnischen Streitkräfte abwenden.

programme.title: Grand Piano - Symphonie der Angst
programme.desc: Die Angst spielt mit, als sich Starpianist Tom Selznick (Elijah Wood) nach einer fünfjährigen Pause wieder an den Konzertflügel setzt. Seinem ehemaligen Lehrer zu Ehren will der unter schwerem Lampenfieber leidende Künstler das 'Unspielbare Stück' aufführen, eine Komposition, die noch kein Pianist fehlerfrei aufführen konnte. Tom hingegen darf gar nicht anders: Eine geheimnisvolle Notiz zwischen den Noten droht ihm mit dem Tod, sollte er nur einmal den falschen Ton treffen...

programme.title: Weltnaturerbe Panama: La Amistad Nationalpark
programme.desc: Die Doku-Serie Weltnaturerbe Mittelamerika bringt Sie in diesem Teil nach Panama und Costa Rica. Genau genommen in den La Amistad Nationalpark, der zwischen den beiden tropischen Ländern beheimatet ist. Das 4.188 Quadratkilometer große Naturschutzgebiet besteht überwiegend aus uraltem Regen- und Nebelwald. 263 Arten von Amphibien und Reptilien wurden bisher entdeckt, die Mehrzahl davon Echsen.

programme.title: Mulan - Legende einer Kriegerin
programme.desc: Als der Kaiser alle Männer Nordchinas aufruft, sich dem Kampf gegen einfallende Barbaren zu stellen, hat das junge Mädchen Mulan Angst um die Gesundheit ihres Vaters. Um ihn zu schützen, verkleidet sie sich als Mann und tritt an seiner Stelle in die Armee ein. Im Kampf zeigt sich ihr großes Talent und außergewöhnlicher Mut. Unter der ständigen Gefahr entdeckt zu werden, wirs sie zur Anführerin, die alles opfern muss, um ihre Nation zu verteidigen und ihre Familie zu ehren.

programme.title: Europa Report
programme.desc: Eine internationale Besatzung von Astronauten unternimmt eine privat finanzierte Mission, um auf Jupiters viertgrößtem Mond nach Leben zu suchen.

programme.title: Voice from the stone
programme.desc: Es spielt in der Toskana der 1950er Jahre und ist die eindringliche und spannende Geschichte von Verena, einer feierlichen Krankenschwester, die einem kleinen Jungen helfen will, der seit dem plötzlichen Tod seiner Mutter verstummt ist.

programme.title: Ein Trauzeuge zum Verlieben
programme.desc: Die smarte Olivia Owens (Cristina Rosato), Managerin eines gemeinnützigen Gartenprojektes, gerät eines Tages mit Bauleiter Brian Wolf (Greyston Holt) aneinander, als dieser neben ihrem Grundstück eine Werbetafel für einen Wohnungsbau in die Erde schlägt, der Olivias grüne Ambitionen ernsthaft bedroht. Und als wäre das noch nicht genug, findet sich Olivia kurze Zeit später nicht nur neben Brian in einer engen Sitzreihe im Bus wieder, sondern muss auch noch feststellen, dass der anstrengende Kerl zur selben Hochzeit eingeladen ist wie sie! Schlimmer noch, während sich Olivia als Brautjungfer für ihre Freundin Jenny (Rebecca Olson) ins Zeug legt, springt Brian dem zukünftigen Bräutigam Richard (Matt Hamilton) als Trauzeuge zur Seite. Leider hat das Hochzeitspaar durchaus ein paar eigene Probleme, und bevor das so wunderschön geplante Wochenende endgültig ins Chaos zu stürzen droht, müssen sich Olivia und Brian wohl oder übel zusammenraufen, um die Hochzeit zu retten. Und so beginnt eine Party, die keiner von ihnen so schnell vergessen wird...

programme.title: Cassandras Traum
programme.desc: Zwei Brüder. Ein Geheimnis. Kein Zurück. Terry und Ian wachsen im Londoner Arbeitermilieu auf – doch ihre Träume könnten unterschiedlicher nicht sein. Während Terry dem Rausch des Glücksspiels verfällt, sehnt sich Ian nach Aufstieg, Erfolg und einem Leben an der Seite der faszinierenden Schauspielerin Angela Stark (Hayley Atwell). Als beide finanziell am Abgrund stehen, bietet sich ihnen ein Ausweg: ein gefährlicher Deal, der ein dunkles Familiengeheimnis ans Licht bringt. Was als Rettung erscheint, wird zum moralischen Albtraum. In einer Welt, in der Loyalität zur Waffe wird und Schuld tiefer schneidet als jede Tat, geraten die Brüder in einen Strudel aus Verlangen, Verrat und Verzweiflung. Wie weit würdest du gehen, um deinen Traum zu retten – und was bleibt von dir, wenn du ihn erreichst?

programme.title: The Legend of Gobi
programme.desc: Vor langer Zeit gab es ein Königreich mit Menschen, die die Musik liebten. Ein königlicher Offizier mit dem Namen Ilger übernimmt die Macht, und ernennt sich selbst zum neuen König. Nach der Machtübernahme lässt er alle Musikinstrumente verbrennen und alle Musiker töten; nur ein Geiger namens Khuguljirgen überlebt. Obwohl der neue König allmächtig scheint, hat er keinen Thronerben. Aus diesem Grund lässt er die Prinzessin Egeerel entführen und in seinen Palast bringen. Mit der Ankunft der Prinzessin beginnen jedoch unerwartete Ereignisse…

programme.title: The Jacket
programme.desc: Jack Starks (Adrien Brody) bekommt im Golfkrieg eine Kugel in den Kopf und wird nach Hause geschickt. Aufgrund des traumatischen Erlebnisses leidet er unter Amnesie. Zurück in der Heimat wird er plötzlich mit einem Mord an einem Cop in Verbindung gebracht, an den er sich jedoch nicht erinnern kann. Um aufzuklären, was wirklich geschah, wird er in eine Nervenheilanstalt eingewiesen und mit schweren Psychopharmaka behandelt. Dort ist er den experimentellen Methoden von Dr. Becker (Kris Kristofferson) hilflos ausgeliefert. Der sperrt ihn in eine Zwangsjacke, verpackt in einen Leichenschrank. Starks hyperventiliert, hat albtraumhafte Visionen, die ihm seinen baldigen Tod offenbaren und kann in die Zukunft reisen. Fieberhaft versucht er nun, das Geflecht aus Vergangenheit und Zukunft, aus Wahrheit und Fantasie zu entwirren und seinen Tod aufzuhalten...

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Tief im dunkelsten Herzen Afrikas, dem unerforschten Kongo, verbirgt sich das mysteriöse Geheimnis einer untergegangenen Stadt. Ihr Name: Zinj. Ein Ort voller uralter Macht und unermesslicher Reichtümer. Das amerikanische High-Tech-Unternehmen TraviCom wittert den Schatz und schickt eine achtköpfige Crew in den Dschungel. Die Satellitenübertragung zeigt: Sie haben Zinj gefunden. Doch dann verstummen die Stimmen. Nur Bilder des Grauens erreichen Amerika – zerschmetterte Ausrüstung, tote Körper, ein Massaker ohne Spuren des Täters. Danach: völlige Stille. Unter der Leitung der entschlossenen Technologieexpertin Dr. Karen Ross (Laura Linney) startet eine zweite Expedition. Mit an Bord: Primatologe Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), seine sprechende Gorilla-Dame Amy und der kampferprobte Captain Monroe Kelly (Ernie Hudson). Was sie erwartet, ist kein Schatz, sondern ein tödliches Geheimnis – eine Stadt, bewacht von uralten Hütern, in einem Land, das keine Gnade kennt.

programme.title: Dog Eat Dog
programme.desc: Drei Männer haben das Gefängnis hinter sich und versuchen, sich an ein Leben in Freiheit zu gewöhnen. Einen Ausrutscher dürfen sie sich nicht erlauben, denn auch der kleinste Verstoß gegen die kalifornischen Bewährungsauflagen würde sie wieder hinter Gitter bringen. Doch Troy (Nicolas Cage), Mad Dog (Willem Dafoe) und Diesel (Christopher Matthew Cook) wollen nach ihren eigenen Regeln leben. Troy, ein arrogantes Genie, träumt zwar von einem einfachen beschaulichen Leben, doch die Schatten der Vergangenheit lassen ihn nicht los. Diesel dagegen steht auf der Gehaltsliste der Mafia und verliert zunehmend das Interesse an seinem Vorstadt-Zuhause und seiner nörgelnden Frau. Und der unberechenbare Mad Dog schlittert von einer Katastrophe in die Nächste. Gemeinsam wollen die drei das perfekte Verbrechen durchziehen. Doch die Polizei ist ihnen dicht auf den Fersen...

programme.title: Norwegian Ninja
programme.desc: Arne Treholt ist der Leiter einer supergeheimen Truppe allmächtiger Ninja-Krieger, die zur Zeit des Kalten Krieges über die Sicherheit und Neutralität ihres Landes wacht. Auf ihrem Stützpunkt, einer Insel vor der norwegischen Küste, trainieren die Helden für den Ernstfall. Dieser tritt bald ein.

programme.title: Escape

Zwar gelingt dem Mädchen als einzige Überlebende bald die Flucht. Aber ihre Verfolger sind ebenso gnadenlos wie die unwirtliche Wildnis im hohen Norden.

programme.desc: More evidence that 1940s prospector Dick Carter was hot on Slumach’s trail emerges through a hidden map. Markings on the map lead the team back to Pitt Lake for one last attempt to find Slumach’s gold before Mother Nature slams her door.

programme.title: His Deadly Affair
programme.desc: Violinist Danielle's dream boyfriend, James the Conductor of the Orchestra, has a dangerous and obsessive wife, who is waiting to extract her vengeance on Danielle.

programme.title: The Music in Me
programme.desc: A singer/songwriter leaves her dreams behind to help her family, until one special guy and a group of musically-challenged strangers help her find her voice again.

programme.title: Deadly Daycare
programme.desc: After a few years of financial hardship, a young mother (RACHEL) decides to go back to work to help her ex-husband with the mounting bills. With no one to watch their 4-year-old daughter (MIA), the mother decides to enroll her into the local daycare center called Little Ones owned by a seemingly responsible older woman, (DEBORAH). After a few weeks of Mia's awkward behavior, Rachel concludes her daughter may be getting mistreated by (GABBY) one of the centers daycare teachers.

programme.title: A Christmas Wedding Date
programme.desc: After Rebecca is fired, she goes back home to see her mother for the holidays where she also attend a wedding on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Target My Daughter
programme.desc: A mother and daughter in a witness protection program are hunted by a ruthless gun for hire.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: Killer Ending
programme.desc: Agatha Sayers best-selling novel becomes her worst nightmare when her daughter is abducted in a copycat scenario.

programme.title: His Deadly Affair

programme.title: Taken Back: Finding Haley
programme.desc: Unable to get over the abduction of her daughter, a mother is convinced she has finally found her, but is she simply a mother obsessed?

programme.title: A Christmas Wish
programme.desc: When Paula chose Gary over Nick, to take her to the senior prom, little did she know that 15 years later she’d be married, have two daughters and tons of debt. When Nick reappears, now a rich, successful art broker, Paula wishes her decision were different. With bills and troubles mounting, especially frustrating during the Christmas season, Paula wishes hard to trade places with Nick’s wife. A little Christmas magic and she is transported to the life with Nick. But, be careful what you wish for… Although she is financially rich, she is far from happy. Eventually her “dream” becomes a “nightmare,” as Nick wants a divorce and she can’t find a way back to Gary and her daughters. Will there be a Merry Christmas?

programme.title: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: In this psychological thriller, a woman with a heart condition begins to suspect that her new husband might not be who she thinks he is.

programme.title: 40 Below & Falling
programme.desc: A rom-com about the adventures of a small town teacher, Kate Carter, going back to the city for her wedding. After a blizzard strikes, she is forced to travel with a stranger named Redford who leaves her questioning her future plans.

programme.title: Fanática
programme.desc: Tess, la protagonista femenina de una popular serie de ciencia-ficción, busca apoyo en su asistente cuando cree que su esposo la traiciona sin saber que está cometiendo un grave error.

programme.title: Presunto Secuestro
programme.desc: Después de sufrir tormentos y abusos a manos de su secuestrador, Elle es liberada repentinamente a un lado de la carretera sin explicación. Su novio Billy y su hermana Jen se apresuran a ayudarla después de que la encuentran, pero la reunión se ve frustrada por los detectives que comienzan a encontrar discrepancias en cada recuento de los eventos que llevaron a la captura de Elle.

programme.title: Amor y Sunshine
programme.desc: Ally ha estado cuidando a Sunshine, un perro militar retirado, mientras se recupera de una ruptura. Pero las chispas vuelven a volar cuando el militar, Jake Terry, regresa para reclamar el perro.

programme.title: Text To Kill

programme.title: Protección: de Testigos

programme.title: Sazonado con amor

programme.title: El Silencio de la Inocencia
programme.desc: La repentina desaparición de su esposa tras del nacimiento de su hijo obliga a Will a iniciar una frenética búsqueda por Europa para recuperar a su familia e intentar reconstruir su vida. A medida que el misterio detrás de las acciones de su esposa comienza a tomar una forma oscura y amenazante, Will está decidido a buscar la verdad, sin importar lo que cueste.

programme.title: Cámara Oculta
programme.desc: Cuando un reportero ganador de un Premio Pulitzer es asesinado en un hotel en Barcelona, su hermano Dan Kovacks comienza su propia investigación, descubriendo pruebas de que su hermano estaba a punto de hacer pública la existencia de un complot internacional bajo el nombre de "Mega-Bill". Una falsificación casi perfecta del billete de 100 dólares estadounidense. Pero los orígenes de la conspiración van más allá de la falsificación de divisas y podría provocar una guerra nuclear entre varios países de gran poder. ¿Quién trabaja para quién? ¿En quién puede confiar Dan?

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.sub-title: La niña de los sueños rotos
programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2007, en Mistrató, Risaralda, fueron hallados los cuerpos incinerados de María del Carmen Arango y su hija María Camila en un cafetal. Un negativo fotográfico intacto reveló al culpable: el sacerdote José Franceis Díaz Toro, esposo y padre de las víctimas, quien las asesinó para ocultar su doble vida y proteger su carrera evangelizadora. Fue condenado a 45 años y 10 meses de cárcel. Su cómplice, el sepulturero José Antonio Morales, también fue capturado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2012, en Cúcuta, Johana Rincón fue hallada muerta en su casa con señales de tortura. Aunque su esposo fue el primer sospechoso, la investigación reveló que el verdadero culpable era su sobrino, quien la asesinó para robar los ahorros de su tío. Tras huir a Venezuela y esconderse durante varios días, fue capturado por la Policía al regresar a Colombia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Virginia, Risaralda, Heidy Yuliani Restrepo, una niña de 11 años, desapareció el 31 de diciembre de 2013 y fue hallada muerta días después en un caño. La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.

programme.title: Amor Secreto

Aunque se niega a contarle la verdad de cómo fue concebida como así tampoco debe enterarse el padre de la existencia de ella. Maribel le exige a Juan Pablo que deje de acosarla. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Horaci the Inuit
programme.desc: Packed with adventure, fun and excitement, HORACI THE INUIT will transport you to the Lands of the North where, together with his best friend Sedna, he will have to solve all kinds of mysteries! Horaci the Inuit takes place in a remote village and talks about universal values such as caring for nature, being intuitive and open-minded and, above all, having a loving respect for family and friends!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.desc: With bow camp starting off strong at the Dirty Bird, Randy is feeling good about the rest of the week. Until Cody decides to head into town and places a small wager with a stranger.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven working on some Big Tine clover maintenance and getting the plot he killed the Boss 8 in during rifle season ready to go. Tune in and get some tips for your clover plots and watch Randy take out the oldest deer on the Raven.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Back at the Raven for bow camp and everything is coming together. Randy has a close encounter with one of the OG bucks on the property while Nate closes the deal on a big five year old.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: It’s the opening week of rifle camp and everyone is ready to go. Big Hoss has a close encounter with a big eight point and Cody finds himself having a little Déjà vu when a big buck walks out into the same plot he killed in last year.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The rut is in full swing at the Raven. Cody goes after a buck he has had several years of history with while Randy is staring at one.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: “Part of our responsibility as citizens in this country is to make sure we not only take care of these resources but we hand it off to the next generation in better condition that we found it.” -Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's Join Bob in New Mexico as he talks about taking care of our natural resources for future generations. Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton meets up with Tom Brewbaker as they fly down to Venice Louisiana to fish with Mike Frenette. Mike runs the Redfish Lodge of Louisiana and has over forty years of angling experience. Mike teaches the guys about the local waters including pogey boats and most importantly, world class red fish.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton goes down North Carolina to learn the family secrets of the Forehand family. Ben Forehand is a guitarist for Christian Contemporary artist Pat Barret. When Ben isn’t playing guitar, he runs Wild and Free Outfitters getting people into the outdoors hunting and fishing, getting their minds off of the everyday grind. . Even though fishing is tough the guys build strong friendships and lasting memories.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton stays close to home and heads to the Lake of The Ozarks joining Austin Culbertson for a frigid couple days of fishing. The cold weather doesn’t hold back the fish, though, as they target brush piles with jerk baits and umbrella rigs.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton and Trevor pack up and drive down to Arkansas for their first experience on the White River. The brothers spend a day in the boat with Bryant Stark of Rising Rivers, fishing the White and the Norfork. Though the White is much larger waters than back home, Trevor utilizes his experience to catch them even while wading.

programme.title: Super Retriever
programme.desc: The Super Retriever Series Crown Championship brings together the nation’s top canine athletes and handlers in Shreveport-Bossier City, Louisiana. In Part 1 of the Amateur Division, teams face off in challenging Retriever Trials alongside high-energy SRS Super Dock competition. Precision, power, and teamwork are put to the test as the road to the Crown begins.

programme.title: Super Retriever
programme.desc: The Amateur Division reaches its climax at the Super Retriever Series Crown Championship. Top teams battle through the final rounds of Retriever Trials, where every point matters. In the end, one standout handler and dog team rises above the rest to be crowned Amateur SRS Crown Champions. At the same time, the excitement continues on the dock as fun-loving canine athletes compete for their own Crown victories in SRS Super Dock.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Josh Dahlke grabs a TenPoint crossbow and kicks back on "Island Time," along with the Nashville rockers from Loose Lips.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Join Will Cooper on an unforgettable adventure in the Colorado mountains, where he dedicated three years chasing elusive bull elk without success. Determined to turn the tide, Will enlists the expertise of his good friend Jermaine Hodge, prior World Elk Calling Champion and Wrestling Coach for the United States Army World Class Athlete Program. Together, they face challenges and overcome adversity during a thrilling public land over-the-counter rifle hunt. Experience the highs and lows of their journey against the stunning backdrop of Colorado's wilderness.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: In the wide world of western big game, pronghorn antelope hunting in Wyoming is unmatched in its accessibility and excitement. It’s an active pursuit, typically ripe with plenty of opportunities to spot and stalk black-horned bucks. This makes it an ideal forum for riflemen looking to scratch their western itch.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade travels to Kansas to try and bag one of the Midwest's most impressive deer!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade ends the saga with a deer he has watched for a few years, Pope. programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.desc: Prince William and Prince Harry, along with their friends, got as much media attention as today’s pop stars, fashion icons, and movie celebs. This documentary explores how this affected their personal lives and friendships, showcasing how they managed their fame alongside their royal responsibilities.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.
